Mod.Name: QuickSL
Mod.Author: 米德
Mod.Description:
实时快速SL，将当铺状态切换至任意快照节点。
辅助功能已拆分至独立模组Shift工具箱；两者可单独使用，双装时共用功能面板。
功能设置请在mod自带的面板中进行设置。
--- English ---
Quick save/load in real time: restore the pawnshop to any snapshot checkpoint.
Utilities now belong to the independent Shift Toolbox mod. Each mod works alone; together they share a feature panel.
Configure features in the mod's own panel.
